properties.notes: This site lies within the Shoreham Harbour Regeneration Area identified as a broad location for change in the Adur Local Plan 2017. The regeneration of Shoreham Harbour has been a long term aspiration and the redevelopment of the Western Harbour Arm is recognised as a priority for the Shoreham Harbour Partnership. Progress is being made to bring this site forward.. SHLAA Ref: SH/001/13
